record.field: Both parties, on the principle of equality, mutual benefit, consideration and agreement, hereby agree on the sale and purchase of the products described below.

Within ____ days after this contract takes effect. For a customer on an agreed payment term the contract takes effect on the signing date; for any other customer it takes effect on the day the supplier receives the down payment agreed in this contract.
Inspected against national and industry standards. Where special requirements apply, the technical agreement signed by the two parties is followed.
Courier / Logistics / Delivered to the door by the supplier / Collected by the buyer.

The buyer inspects the products within 3 days of delivery and returns the delivery note signed and stamped to the supplier. A delivery note not returned within 3 days counts as acceptance. Damage caused in transport is claimed to the supplier within 3 days and the supplier answers within 3 days; the supplier bears no risk of transport damage claimed later. The VAT invoice is issued in the month of a successful inspection.

Monthly settlement / Full payment before delivery / Down payment of ______ yuan, the balance paid before delivery. The bank and the account of the supplier are the ones written in the party block above.
Borne by the supplier / Borne by the buyer, ______ yuan (charged as the carrier actually bills).

18 months counted from the day the products leave the factory. A product beyond the warranty period is not returned or exchanged. Within the warranty period the supplier bears the transport cost of a quality problem caused by process design or material defects; the buyer bears the transport and repair cost of a return that is not a quality problem, of a specially customised product and of stock returned by the buyer. A labelled product is not returned or exchanged for a non-quality reason.
A dispute over this contract is settled by the two parties in good time; where no settlement is reached, the case is filed with the people court of the place where the supplier is located.
A fax or a scan confirmed by the two parties is legally valid. A hand-written entry must not be altered twice, otherwise it is void.
